producer.name: performance_classification.py
limits: This record binds the PFP-1 classification and its declared identity; it executes nothing.
It does not establish that the cited campaign occurred as described; the PFP-1 receipt is the record of that.
The PFP-1 comparison is within-candidate (setup versus prepared); it is not a comparison against an external library.
A green validation is a statement about claim form, not about the truth of the measurement.

artefact.label: distribution-shaped libcrypto.so.3 from HEAD 91ac573c0 with the PFP-1 patch applied
artefact.obligation: The benchmarked DSO was built in the campaign workspace from an uncommitted patch and is not committed; its digest, patch digest and build identity are tracked, the bytes are not.

comparators.reason: not measured in PFP-1; the campaign compares the prepared path with its own setup-inclusive arm

instrument.name: bench_pfp1.c with analyse_pfp1.py
measures: within-candidate single-operation latency, setup-inclusive versus prepared context
paired per-repetition ratios of setup to prepared medians

samples.unit_of_replication: one process per mode per repetition
samples.statistic: median over repetitions of setup_us / prepared_us

population.completeness_rule: The realised identifier set equals the frozen WORKLOADS identifier set; the results file records the same nine-element family.

scope.security_profile: candidate distribution-shaped libcrypto.so.3 at digest 596f4833 against the same source HEAD without the patch; within-candidate comparison, no external arm
exclusions: no external comparator is measured in PFP-1
EC is reported as unchanged because PFP-1 gives it no second mode
L1 and L2 arithmetic kernels are not measured separately
L4 protocol and L5 downstream workloads are not measured
constant-time behaviour is recorded by ctgrind at the same digest but is not proved by this record

threat_model.statement: Private exponents, RSA private operands and ECDSA nonces and keys are SECRET_DATA; moduli and group orders are public. PFP-1 adds no secret-dependent branch by design, and the receipt records ctgrind at the same digest; that is bounded evidence, not a constant-time proof.
threat_model.observation_model: wall-clock latency on a virtualised host; no PMU, no cache or branch counters, no frequency, turbo or SMT control

venue.description: existing court container, 6g/6g cap, pinned CPU 1; the results file records venue_has_pmu=false

open.description: Secret ownership does not propagate through the arithmetic itself; PFP-1 changes the prepared-domain ownership but does not close the transfer window.
The constant-time inversion's scratch storage and the operands' normalised limb-count metadata remain the recorded residual.
The ECDSA per-signature allocation blow-up is unchanged by PFP-1 and remains open.
The measured comparison is setup-inclusive versus prepared within the candidate; no external comparator was executed.
The candidate was built from an uncommitted patch at 91ac573c0; the patch digest is recorded but the candidate is not reproducible from a commit.
The venue exposes no PMU and has no frequency, turbo, SMT or isolation control; every row is SCOPED_OBSERVATION.
